questions.stem: A 29-year-old Rh-negative woman, 30 weeks pregnant, presents for a routine follow-up. She has a history of a previous pregnancy complicated by Rh incompatibility but has been receiving appropriate prenatal care. Recent laboratory tests reveal a positive indirect Coombs test with elevated anti-Rh antibodies. The fetal ultrasound shows normal growth and no significant abnormalities. What is the most likely diagnosis for the fetus?

options.label: D
options.text: Severe Hemolytic Disease of Newborn with Normal Growth
